close_reason: Rewrote 6 sites in space.rs as self-contained statements of the rule. Verified via per-site visibility audit (python script attached to commit description) that memory.rs's 19 candidate leak sites are ALL on #[doc(hidden)] test helpers, trait impl method overrides (which inherit the trait method rustdoc), private fn items, or items inside #[cfg(test)] modules. None render in published rustdoc regardless of docs.rs config landing (JMAP-ch6h). The bead's premise that those memory.rs sites would 'become visible once docs.rs config is fixed' was incorrect on re-verification. The space.rs edits stand because they improve source-readable comments for developers reading the source without access to the Beads tracker. Commit 38570af. clippy + rustdoc -D warnings + lib tests all green.
description:
## Finding

JMAP-x2gd.60 enumerated 10 `bd:JMAP-*` references in `backend.rs`,
`lib.rs`, and `permissions.rs` that leak into rendered rustdoc.
That bead was closed by rewriting those sites. A broader grep across
`crate-jmap-chat-server/src/` finds the same pattern in `///` and
`//!` doc-comment positions in:

- `src/space.rs`: lines 289, 313, 335, 353, 610, 634
- `src/memory.rs`: lines 267, 291, 296, 327, 346, 363, 855, 867, 868,
  869, 881, 913, 948, 1107, 1281, 1412, 2682, 3062, 3101

(Verify with `grep -n 'bd:JMAP-' src/space.rs src/memory.rs` then
inspect each hit for `///` vs `//` prefix.)

`memory.rs` is feature-gated behind `memory` and currently invisible
on docs.rs (tracked as JMAP-ch6h). Once docs.rs config is fixed,
those leaks become visible.

`//` source comments (e.g. `space.rs:603`, `space.rs:1054`,
`message.rs:446`) are NOT in scope of this sweep — they are
internal source-tree pointers, not rendered docs.

## Fix shape

Same as JMAP-x2gd.60: replace each `bd:JMAP-*` reference with a
self-contained statement of the rule, or remove the reference
entirely when it adds nothing to consumer-facing meaning.

## Scope policy

This sweep is chat-server-LOCAL. A broader workspace-wide audit
(every `crate-jmap-*/src/`) is a separate, larger effort that
should be filed as its own epic if and when it's prioritised.
title: API contract: bd:JMAP-* in published rustdoc — broader sweep beyond .60's 10 named sites
